aggregation.conditional: Also report the subset initially ambiguous, with separate explicit denominators. This is secondary, not a replacement for the all-case results.
aggregation.figure: Four panels, factorial/constructed by unit/heterogeneous costs. Plot mean paid cost normalized by initial available total against percentage of instances certified. Points correspond to the fixed six budget fractions; lines connect displayed operating points, without asserting intermediate optimality. Show all seven methods.
aggregation.main: Each case has weight one. Average its four tie-slot indicators and costs first, then average across cases. Retain all initially certified cases in every main denominator.
metrics: mean paid fraction of initial available cost
aggregation.uncertainty: Descriptive deterministic benchmark; no population confidence intervals or significance tests. Shared structural draws and identical deterministic slots are not independent observations.

budgets.denominator: Sum of stated costs for all initially available query candidates, including logically irrelevant candidates; each budget is that instance-specific sum times its exact Fraction grid value.
budgets.interpretation: Synthetic normalized acquisition allowance, not human time or monetary cost. Normalization is policy-independent and fixed before acquisition. The full denominator includes irrelevant labels, so values depend on pool composition.
budgets.rule: Canonical prefix truncation. Prescribe the same next query as in an unbudgeted run, using all remaining available candidates; halt before paying for or observing it if it exceeds the remaining budget. Do not switch to an affordable query. These are budget-truncated existing methods, not policies optimized for certification probability under a budget.
budgets.zero_total: Budget is zero at all fractions if the initial available total is zero. These frozen cases have positive available costs.

execution.optimization: Generate every complete trace once through the public unified runner. A budgeted result is the longest affordable prefix of that fixed trace. Because queries have nonnegative costs and the full trace stops at the first exact certificate, a truncated prefix is certified iff it includes the entire trace. Check this claim against direct public-runner budget calls on the deterministic verification subset.
execution.public_api: benchmark_runner.run_instance or run_case, using policy_runner.run_policy through canonical adapters and the standard public Panel input representation.
execution.response_access: Responses are exposed through the guarded answer callback after selection. Full traces are generated without giving a policy future answers; prefix extraction is offline reporting and is not supplied back to selection.

research_question: At fixed synthetic acquisition budgets, what fraction of fixed-pick membership decisions do canonical policies certify, and how much of that budget do they use?
scope: Existing synthetic cases only; no new human data, assumed response distribution, budget-optimality claim, or estimate of recruiter workload.

selection.rule: Exactly benchmark_extensions.selected_instances(computational_design): all factorial nonanswer_probability==0 records and all constructed positive_multilabel/coverage_negative records; no filtering by outcomes, initial certificates, or policy performance.

status: Internal design amendment fixed before computing budgeted outcomes; not a preregistration.
ties: Reuse original stable_seed(original seed, tie, instance ID, replicate). Allen cached DNF is deterministic and has four identical slots, not four independent replicates.

checks: Protected old inputs unchanged before and after run
All full public-runner traces reproduce existing per-slot acquisition query counts and costs
Every case and tie slot retained in each budget row
Zero budget yields exactly initial certificates (selected costs strictly positive)
Full budget yields the original final verdict for all cases and methods
Certification and paid costs are nondecreasing as budget increases
No charged cost exceeds its exact Fraction budget
All recorded certificates use only revealed answers, classify to the reported verdict, and cost no more than acquisition
Every prefix agrees with direct runner calls for all methods, slots, and budgets on the deterministic verification subset
No duplicate physical acquisition; all selected binary answers agree with the acquired guarded record
Cached DNF rejects a nonanswer explicitly rather than silently treating it as a binary label
verification.direct_subset: For each of the four phase-by-cost strata, sort instance IDs by SHA256(UTF-8 ID), breaking ties lexicographically, and select the first four. This rule is frozen without viewing budget outcomes.
